title: Wild AG hero
description: A window-tall video that stays fixed in place, with a thin down-arrow at its foot, and below it a taupe-to-sand band with a 73px rounded bottom that slides up over the footage as you scroll. The band holds a centred uppercase headline mixing regular sans words with light serif-italic ones, a one-line lead and a paper pill; they fade up one after another as they come into view.
notes: the media slot is fixed to the window (clip-path window); empty, a soft sand placeholder
headline parts with serif: true are set in the display serif italic
the band's text is paper-coloured on the brand gradient in both modes
made to sit under wild-ag-header, which overlays the footage
